questions.question: What did Elihu say about a person's righteousness or sin?
options: It changes how God deals with the whole world
It affects other people, not God himself
It means nothing in the end to anyone
It earns a swift reward or punishment
questions.answer: It affects other people, not God himself

questions.question: Why did Elihu say God sometimes does not answer cries?
options: Because of the pride and emptiness of those crying out
Because he is far too busy to attend to them
Because he is altogether deaf to every one of their cries
Because he is asleep and simply does not hear
questions.answer: Because of the pride and emptiness of those crying out

questions.question: Elihu said your wickedness concerns a man like yourself, and your righteousness a son of man.
Elihu asked, 'If you are righteous, what do you give to _____?'
Elihu said God does not hear an _____ cry.
